items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: And then I went to Danville, Illinois, and joined Jimmy Rochelle's band, which was a Territory band

ctx.x: Right there in Grand Rapids, or did you tour?

Yeah. No, we never did that (tour). And then I went to Danville, Illinois, and joined Jimmy Rochelle's band, which was a Territory band, and Bernie Peacock was with us. And then I met A. K. Atkinson, he was working in a road house in that town, along with Clark Terry. And Jimmy Rochelle had a Territory band. He sang a little song and we played dance music and we played arrangements and the main influence was Milt Buckner on piano. He was like an older brother to me and I learned a lot from him. And we worked…
and we reminisced about all that, 'cause we did a six month tour there. But that was two great experiences for me. And Bernie Peacock was a very fine alto player and he was a real friend. Yeah.
